scope: Bounded local snapshot journal, graph reconstruction, explicit reconciliation boundary and reference-aware artifact garbage collection. No OS worker supervisor, host eligibility implementation, live proving or performance qualification.

implementation.feature_gate: block-v2; Linux only. Default verifier, historical proof bytes, ABI and activation unchanged.
implementation.format: Local LVDAG001 metadata in an LVJRN001 generation/length/Poseidon2-checksummed frame. Bounded manual codec; not a consensus/network format or append-only audit history.
implementation.publication: Create-new private staging file, write, file fsync, atomic rename of authoritative state, directory fsync. Every core mutation commits before returning; failed/uncertain commits disable further dispatch.
implementation.recovery: Exact profile/construction/chain/configuration match and strictly newer epoch. Bounded structural metadata checks precede CPU wallet/node verification. Jobs reconstructed through original constructors. Old candidates become reports only; completed caches remain, unfinished jobs are dormant.
implementation.reconciliation: Recovery exposes no dispatch API. Caller must authoritatively stop/drain every recorded unresolved exact worker/device/verifier lease before resume. A failed callback leaves previous durable state retryable. Resume rebases retention and commits a fresh session before returning.
implementation.admission_errors: Pre-write malformed input and quota rejection no longer poison the whole coordinator unless the artifact store itself requires recovery. Such rejection neither accepts proof results nor releases active verifier reservations.
implementation.gc: Commit removed DAG references before deleting unreferenced recognized store artifacts. Retained dependency closure and unreleased reservations remain protected. Published orphan proofs are never inferred to be completed jobs.
implementation.trust_boundary: Dedicated private Linux directory; procfs, exclusive kernel lock, atomic rename and directory fsync required. Same-uid processes/kernel/filesystem trusted. Logical byte bounds are not physical disk quotas; subprocess exits do not qualify physical power-loss durability.

validation.ignored_explanation: Three pinned CPU fixture tests are run explicitly afterward; two subprocess helpers are explicitly invoked by the artifact-store and journal crash tests.
checks: Rustfmt edition 2021 --check over execution module tree

structural: Exclusive ownership, captured-directory authority after path replacement, changed locks, private modes, symlinks, unknown entries and bounded pending inventory.
Four injected errors and four abrupt subprocess exits across write/file-fsync/rename/directory-fsync boundaries; staging never substitutes for missing or corrupt authoritative state.
Completed-cache recovery with fresh sessions; old candidate/lease rejection, explicit new eligibility and sealing.
Unresolved worker and active verifier reconciliation; failed reconciliation retry, retention rebasing and eventual GC.
Durability after mutations and error paths; duplicate accepted completions, conflicting replacements and cancelled verification.
Ordinary input/quota rejection preserves service availability and active verifier accounting.
Failed completion commit cannot promote its published orphan; failed prune commit cannot delete still-referenced artifacts.
Invalid snapshot counts, configuration, epoch, operation/range/arity/lifecycle/manifests rejected before proof callbacks; corrupt/missing referenced artifacts rejected.
real_cpu: Existing pinned job-contract and artifact-store replays repeated.
Public DurableDag::recover re-verifies eight real wallets and their cached level-three/count-eight root against independent profile/registry/root pins.
Wrong chain/epoch and mutated stored root rejected; partial root is not accepted as a block candidate.
Fresh-session recovery preserves seven semantic jobs and nine artifacts; retention-aware journaled pruning removes only temporary store copies.
Standalone CPU root verification passes after those temporary artifacts are removed; recovery of the durably empty graph succeeds. Original source fixtures preserved.

remaining: Real bounded CPU worker adapter, OS process identity/reconciliation and physical aggregate resource enforcement.
Host eligibility revalidation and versioned host integration; recovery reports are not block acceptance.
Arrival-driven tests with real proving, cancellation/restart and complete seal-to-host-ready timing.
GPU transfer-reduction work and controlled, repeated matched performance measurements.
Full64 cold/complete post-seal gates, mixed transaction types/issuance, full-tree soundness/ZK review and explicit activation.
Storage-device/filesystem power-loss qualification and sustained operational testing.
